title: pre-gate evidence bundle
description: Output of scripts/pre-gate-bundle.sh --json (Thor card b45884fb). Mechanical, reproducible evidence sheet handed to the merge gate.

base_anchor.description: Whether `git fetch origin` succeeded before the 3-dot diff. "stale" means the fetch FAILED and the diff ran against a possibly-outdated on-disk origin/<branch> -- a green verdict then says nothing about the current remote tip.

verdict.description: Aggregate result. Any check BLOCK -> BLOCK; else any WARN -> WARN; else PASS.

checks.description: One entry per mechanical check, in execution order.

name.description: Check identifier (e.g. typecheck, tests, diff-size, static).

detail.description: Human-readable evidence. Never contains a secret value -- only pattern names and counts.

diff_additions.description: Total added lines across the diff (binary files count as 0).

cross_model.description: Optional advisory. Present only with --cross-model. Flags an unexpected/cross Claude model id introduced by the diff. Never affects verdict or exit code.

model.description: The model id the cross-check ran against, when known.

flags.description: Advisory flag names (e.g. prompt-leak-detected). Empty when nothing was flagged.

low_findings.description: Only with status=partial: ids of the low/info findings that did not warrant a FLAG.

skill_check.description: Optional advisory. Present only with --skill-check. Never affects verdict or exit code.

detail.description: Last SKILL-REGRESSION: line, or the reason the check was skipped.

da_sentinel.description: Advisory. Emitted on every --json run (check_da_sentinel is unconditional): whether a DA T1 sentinel exists in DA_RUNS_DIR. Never affects verdict or exit code.
